facts.fact: The Journal of the Academic Forum article abstract says a legislative vacuum in Libya leaves AI-related crimes, including deepfakes, unaddressed, and that Libyan legislation must be updated.

facts.fact: The Journal of the Academic Forum article abstract says Libya has a legislative vacuum on AI-related crimes and that Libyan legislation needs updating to cover them.
